extracted.intended_audience: UK residential consumers considering Sky TV, broadband, and mobile packages
extracted.subtask_description: Terms, eligibility rules, technical requirements, fees, guarantees and add‑on conditions for Sky TV (Streaming/Glass/Stream), Sky Broadband, and related streaming services in the UK. Covers minimum speeds, delivery/returns, subscription minimum terms, add‑on pricing, and guarantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing basis and variable pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: £1 per day based on new Sky TV customers joining Sky Ultimate TV at £24 per month on a 24-month minimum term (rolling monthly price £38 per month). Prices may change during your minimum term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how the advertised '£1 per day' price is calculated, the 24‑month minimum term, the rolling price after the minimum, and warns prices may change during the minimum term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass offer savings statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Save up to £240 based on 65” Sky Glass Gen 2 TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advertised saving is tied to a specific model/size (65" Sky Glass Gen 2) and is a headline saving statement; full terms/details elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: HBO Max inclusion and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to HBO Max Basic with Ads is included with your Sky Ultimate TV subscription ... HBO Max is streamed over broadband; a minimum download speed of 5 Mbps is recommended for HBO Max Basic with Ads and HBO Max Standard and 50 Mbps for HBO Max Premium. To access HBO Max, you will need to have or create an HBO Max account and agree to HBO Max’s terms of use and privacy policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains included tier, recommended minimum broadband speeds per HBO Max tier, requirement to create/agree to HBO Max account/terms, and note that streaming depends on broadband.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of pre-existing HBO Max subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions. To avoid this, manage your existing subscription with your current provider before activating HBO Max through Sky.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customer responsibility to manage existing third‑party subscriptions to avoid duplicate billing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disney+ inclusion and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to Disney+ Standard with Ads is included in Sky Ultimate TV and Sky Cinema subscriptions ... Disney+ is streamed over broadband; a minimum download speed of 5 Mbps is recommended for Disney+ Standard with Ads and Disney+ Standard and 25 Mbps for Disney+ Premium. To access Disney+, you will need to have or create a Disney+ account and agree to Disney’s terms of use and privacy policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies included tier, recommended speeds for tiers, and requirement to have/agree to Disney+ account and terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valuation of included services
rubrics_metrics.description: Disney+ Standard with Ads worth £5.99 a month (based on Disney’s regular monthly price).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives an indicative monetary value for included third‑party services to justify bundle value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass delivery and return terms
rubrics_metrics.description: By courier. Choose from Standard (£0) or Premium delivery (£45). Someone aged 18 or over will need to be home to sign for it. A £25 fee applies for returning Glass within the 31-day cooling off period, which will be added to your next bill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States delivery cost options, age requirement for signature, and a return fee if returned during cooling‑off period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming TV subscription requirement for Sky Glass
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Glass TV requires new or existing Sky TV Streaming subscription (from £15 a month for new streaming TV customers with 24-month minimum term. Prices may change during 24-month minimum) Further terms apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sky Glass hardware requires an active Sky Streaming TV subscription and may be subject to minimum term pricing and other terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Ultra HD and Dolby Atmos Pack (£6pm extra. 31-day rolling subscription) required to watch Sky content in UHD/HDR and with Dolby Atmos. 31 days’ notice to cancel. Dolby Digital Plus must be enabled in Settings to experience Dolby Atmos sound. Not all content available in UHD and/or HDR. Requires broadband min speed 30Mb/s. Offers end 11/02/26.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies price, billing cadence, cancellation notice, device/settings requirements, content availability caveat, minimum broadband speed and offer end date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential TV and channel inclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes a selection of entertainment and general interest channels including Sky Atlantic, Netflix Standard with Ads and discovery+.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines what channels/services are bundled in the Essential TV package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription options and minimum terms (new and existing customers)
rubrics_metrics.description: New Sky TV customers options: £15pm ... with a 24-month minimum term or £18pm with a 31-day rolling subscription ... Existing Sky TV customers options: £18pm ... with a 24-month minimum term or £21pm with a 31-day rolling subscription, then auto-renews at standard monthly rolling price.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different pricing and term options for new vs existing customers; auto‑renewal at standard rolling price; prices may change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation and mounting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Both Sky Glass and Sky Stream puck can be self-installed. You must use a professional installer to wall mount Sky Glass.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows self‑install but requires professional installer for wall mounting (safety/guarantee/installation quality reason).

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming technical minimums and device limits
rubrics_metrics.description: All content on Sky Glass and Sky Stream is streamed via broadband, minimum speed of 25mbps recommended. Maximum of 3 Sky Glass TVs and 6 Sky Stream Pucks per account/household.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets recommended broadband minimum and the maximum number of devices per account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Stream hardware requirement and delivery cutoffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires TV with HDMI port. Delivery: By courier. Order by 9pm (Mon-Fri) or 3pm (Sunday) for next working day delivery (excludes Bank Holidays).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies hardware compatibility (HDMI) and ordering deadlines for next day delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device feature setup requirements (Voice/Glance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Glass Gen 2: Must be set up in enhanced mode to use Voice or Glance to turn TV on from standby. Sky Glass Air: Must be set up in networked standby mode to use Voice to turn TV on from standby.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain features require specific setup modes; availability of colours/sizes subject to availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass and Sky Glass Air pricing and purchase/loan options
rubrics_metrics.description: Pricing for Sky Glass Air: One-time payment of £309 for 43”, £509 for 55” and £649 for 65”. Pricing for Sky Glass Gen 2: One-time payment of £699 for 43”, £949 for 55” and £1199 for 65”. Options to purchase with a loan (Consumer Credit Agreement - CCA): Upfront fee £20.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists outright purchase prices by size and notes CCA loan purchasing option with upfront fee; refers to full pricing details links.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCA regulation for consumer credit
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky UK Limited is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (Reference Number 712293) for consumer credit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates consumer credit products are FCA‑regulated and gives reference number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy efficiency ratings disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy efficiency ratings for Sky Glass Air TVs: On a scale of A-G, 43": Rated F; 55": Rated F; 65": Rated F. Energy efficiency ratings for Sky Glass Gen 2 TVs: On a scale of A-G, 43": Rated G; 55": Rated E; 65": Rated E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the official energy efficiency ratings by model/size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Netflix streaming requirements and account handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Netflix Standard with Ads is included ... minimum download speed per stream of 3 Mb/s for Netflix Standard with Ads (HD content) and 5 Mb/s for Netflix Standard (HD content) and 25 Mb/s for Netflix Premium (Ultra HD content) is recommended. For pre-existing Netflix customers taking Sky Essential TV or Ultimate TV subscriptions: your Netflix bill will automatically transfer from Netflix to Sky.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies recommended speeds for Netflix tiers and explains automatic transfer of billing for pre‑existing Netflix customers and what happens if you cancel Streaming TV subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit on multiple Sky TV subscriptions at one address
rubrics_metrics.description: You can only have one Sky TV subscription at your address, so if you already have Sky Q or Sky+ you will need to end your current Sky TV subscription and take a new Sky Ultimate TV subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enforces one Sky TV subscription per address; explains impacts on existing minimum terms, recordings, billing and need to return Sky Q boxes within 60 days to avoid non-return charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of moving between packages on add-ons and recordings
rubrics_metrics.description: Any recordings you have on Sky Q or Sky+ will not transfer to Sky Glass or Sky Stream puck. Sky Store Buy and Keep purchases will still be accessible via the Sky Store app.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warns customers migrating platforms that recordings may not transfer but Buy & Keep purchases remain accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole Home subscription requirement for using both Sky Stream and Sky Glass
rubrics_metrics.description: If you want to use both products together, then you will need to get a Whole Home subscription (currently £15pm extra). Requires broadband, min speed 30Mb/s.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies additional monthly cost and minimum broadband speed to use multiple devices together across the home.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming TV add‑ons: Ad Skipping terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Ad Skipping: £6pm on a 31-day rolling subscription. Ad Skipping allows fast-forwarding through ads in on-demand content, including all Sky and paid Entertainment VOD, ITVX, and Channel 4 apps. Excludes Netflix. Cancel anytime. 31 days’ notice required to cancel. Requires Streaming TV subscription and Sky Glass or Sky Stream.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details price, coverage, exclusions (Netflix), cancellation notice, and hardware/subscription prerequisites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Cinema add‑on pricing and minimum term interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Cinema: £14pm extra with a 24 month minimum term for Sky Cinema on Sky Glass and Sky Stream when you take or renew Streaming TV subscription with a 24 month minimum term. ... Standard price (currently £17pm extra) applies when signing up to a 31-day rolling subscription or outside minimum term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Illustrates how add‑on pricing depends on whether customer takes 24‑month minimum terms vs rolling subscriptions and interactions with other add‑ons for combined minimum terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third‑party streaming services (discovery+, Paramount+) terms and speeds
rubrics_metrics.description: discovery+: Access ... streamed via broadband, minimum download speed 5 Mb/s and 20 Mb/s for 4K content. Separate discovery+ account setup required. Paramount+: streamed via broadband, minimum download speed 2 Mb/s and 25 Mb/s for 4K UHD and HDR content. Separate Paramount+ account setup required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies recommended speeds for discovery+ and Paramount+, requires separate account setup, and warns about duplicate subscriptions and how to avoid them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voucher/promotion rules (Vue Cinema Tickets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotion available until 30 June 2027. Sky Cinema customers can claim up to two standard tickets per month ... Voucher codes must be used within the same calendar month they are generated, or they will expire. Codes cannot be combined with other ticket offers, and each voucher code is valid for one ticket only. If you cancel your Sky Cinema subscription, access to this promotion will end when your subscription ends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists eligibility, monthly limits, expiry rules, exclusions (e.g., not for trial members), and tie to active subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Kids Pack and cancellation
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Kids Pack: £8pm extra. Cancel anytime. 31 days’ notice to cancel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple add‑on pricing and cancellation notice requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Sports and TNT Sports add‑on pricing and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Sports: £33pm extra with a 24 month minimum terms ... Standard price (currently £35pm extra) applies when signing up to a 31-day rolling subscription ... TNT Sports: £34pm extra on a 31-day rolling subscription. Cancel anytime. 31 days’ notice required to cancel. Requires Streaming TV subscription and Sky Glass or Sky Stream. Not available to existing TNT Sports subscribers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies different pricing by term, cancellation notice, prerequisite hardware/subscription and availability exclusions for existing subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole Home device setup and additional puck pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Whole Home: £15pm extra on a 31-day rolling subscription, to watch Sky TV on multiple compatible devices ... Requires an additional Sky Glass TV or a Sky Stream puck (Set-up £0 first additional puck, £39.95 extra per puck thereafter) and broadband, min speed 30Mb/s. Additional 5Mb/s required for each Sky Stream puck added.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains per‑puck setup fees, additional bandwidth requirements per puck and device compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: My Sky app and device/software requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: My Sky app: Available on compatible Apple and Android devices. Requires WiFi/3G/4G/5G (charges may apply). See device and software requirements here and the App Store or Google Play Store. App features and functions vary by platform/device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs customers to check device/software compatibility and notes variable feature availability by platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Go streaming availability and minimum speed
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Go: Sky TV customers only. Selected live channels and on demand content available in line with your Sky TV subscription at no extra cost. UK only. Streamed via WiFi/3G/4G/5G (charges may apply). Minimum speed 2Mb/s. Available on registered compatible devices (content may vary and depends on your Sky TV package). Some live TV programmes will be unavailable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies customer eligibility, minimum streaming speed, device registration, regional availability and content limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadband product availability, fees and consents
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject to status. Speeds vary by location. Separate 24-month minimum term contracts apply to Sky Broadband, Sky Talk, Sky Broadband Boost, and Sky WiFi Max. ... Set-up fee of £9.95 router delivery plus £10 activation fee may be required. Non-standard set-up may cost extra. You must get any consents required (e.g. landlord’s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that broadband availability and speeds depend on location/status, lists standard setup/activation fees, separate minimum terms, and customer responsibility to obtain consents like landlord permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loaned Sky kit return requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Any Sky kit is loaned to you at no cost and must be returned at the end of your broadband subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers must return loaned hardware on end of subscription; failure to return may incur charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed Guarantee for broadband
rubrics_metrics.description: If the download speed to your hub drops below your guaranteed minimum download speed for three consecutive days or more, you will have the right to leave your Sky Broadband and Talk contracts without incurring early termination charges. ... Speed checks must be done using sky.com/servicechecker, the MySky app or by speaking to one of our service advisors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the remedy (right to leave without early termination charges) when guaranteed speed is missed for 3+ consecutive days, excludes total loss/major outages, and prescribes approved speed check methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: WiFi Guarantee with Boost (eligibility and remedy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Available to new Ultrafast customers and as a re-contract for existing customers with Sky Broadband Boost. Min. 3Mb/s - Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed - or money back and you can cancel your Sky Broadband Boost subscription without any early termination charges. Claim once anytime during 24-month min. term. Money back will be one month of your broadband and Sky Broadband Boost subscriptions credited to your Sky account. ... Claim only valid if using Sky router and booster(s). Not available with Sky Broadband Essential Plus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies eligibility, minimum WiFi speed threshold, requirement for engineer visit to confirm, remedy (one month credit and option to cancel), claim frequency limits and equipment constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: WiFi Max Guarantee (eligibility, exclusions and conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires any Sky fibre or NOW Powered by Sky fibre product and WiFi Max. Min. 10Mb/s for Sky Broadband Superfast 35 ... Min. 25Mb/s for Sky Broadband Ultrafast ... Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed - or money back and you can cancel your WiFi Max subscription without any early termination charges. This Guarantee does not cover gardens or any external rooms, buildings or structures such as sheds or garden offices. Claim once anytime during 24-month min. term after first 14 days and when paying for broadband. One claim per address. Claim valid only if using Sky Max Hub and Sky Max Pod(s) and Device Priority is switched off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives product and speed thresholds by product, remedy and cancellation rights, exclusions (external buildings), timing/claim frequency and hardware/software conditions for claim validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product safety information link
rubrics_metrics.description: For product safety information, click here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates separate product safety information is available via a provided link.
